[package]
name = "deadpool"
version = "0.12.3"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Michael P. Jung <michael.jung@terreon.de>"]
description = "Dead simple async pool"
keywords = ["async", "database", "pool"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/deadpool-rs/deadpool"
readme = "README.md"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[features]
default = ["managed", "unmanaged"]
managed = []
unmanaged = []
rt_tokio_1 = ["deadpool-runtime/tokio_1"]
rt_async-std_1 = ["deadpool-runtime/async-std_1"]
rt_smol_2 = ["deadpool-runtime/smol_2"]

[dependencies]
num_cpus = "1.11.1"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.103"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.deadpool-runtime]
version = "0.1"
path = "../deadpool-runtime"

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.5"
features = ["sync"]

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"

[dev-dependencies]
itertools = "0.14"
macro_rules_attribute = "0.2.2"
smol-macros = "0.1.1"

[dev-dependencies.async-std]
version = "1.0"
features = ["attributes"]

[dev-dependencies.config]
version = "0.15"
features = ["json"]

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
version = "0.5"
features = ["html_reports", "async_tokio"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.5.0"
features = ["macros", "rt", "rt-multi-thread", "time"]

[[bench]]
name = "managed"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "unmanaged"
harness = false

[package]
name = "deadpool-redis"
version = "0.23.0"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Michael P. Jung <michael.jung@terreon.de>", "Subeom Choi <subumm1@gmail.com>"]
description = "Dead simple async pool for redis"
keywords = ["async", "redis", "pool"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/deadpool-rs/deadpool"
readme = "README.md"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
rustdoc-args = ["--cfg", "docsrs"]

[features]
default = ["rt_tokio_1"]
rt_tokio_1 = ["deadpool/rt_tokio_1", "tokio-comp"]
rt_smol_2 = ["deadpool/rt_smol_2", "smol-comp"]
serde = ["deadpool/serde", "dep:serde"]
acl = ["redis/acl"]
ahash = ["redis/ahash"]
bigdecimal = ["redis/bigdecimal"]
bloom = ["redis/bloom"]
cache-aio = ["redis/cache-aio"]
cluster = ["redis/cluster-async"]
cluster-async = ["cluster"]
connection-manager = ["redis/connection-manager"]
entra-id = ["redis/entra-id"]
geospatial = ["redis/geospatial"]
json = ["redis/json"]
num-bigint = ["redis/num-bigint"]
rust_decimal = ["redis/rust_decimal"]
script = ["redis/script"]
sentinel = ["redis/sentinel", "dep:tokio", "tokio/sync"]
smol-comp = ["redis/smol-comp"]
smol-native-tls-comp = ["redis/smol-native-tls-comp"]
smol-rustls-comp = ["redis/smol-rustls-comp"]
streams = ["redis/streams"]
tls-native-tls = ["redis/tls-native-tls"]
tls-rustls = ["redis/tls-rustls"]
tls-rustls-insecure = ["redis/tls-rustls-insecure"]
tls-rustls-webpki-roots = ["redis/tls-rustls-webpki-roots"]
token-based-authentication = ["redis/token-based-authentication"]
tokio-comp = ["redis/tokio-comp"]
tokio-native-tls-comp = ["redis/tokio-native-tls-comp"]
tokio-rustls-comp = ["redis/tokio-rustls-comp"]
uuid = ["redis/uuid"]
vector-sets = ["redis/vector-sets"]

[dependencies.deadpool]
path = "../deadpool"
version = "0.12.0"
default-features = false
features = ["managed"]

[dependencies.redis]
version = "1.4.1"
default-features = false
features = ["aio"]

[dependencies.serde]
package = "serde"
version = "1.0"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.6"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"

[dev-dependencies]
dotenvy = "0.15.0"
futures = "0.3.15"

[dev-dependencies.config]
version = "0.15"
features = ["json"]

[dev-dependencies.redis]
version = "1.4.1"
default-features = false
features = ["tokio-comp"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.6"
features = ["macros", "rt-multi-thread", "sync"]

[package]
name = "deadpool-runtime"
version = "0.1.5"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.85"
authors = ["Michael P. Jung <michael.jung@terreon.de>"]
description = "Dead simple async pool utilities for async runtimes"
keywords = ["async", "database", "pool", "sync", "utils"]
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/deadpool-rs/deadpool"
readme = "README.md"

[features]
async-std_1 = ["dep:async-std_1"]
smol_2 = ["dep:smol_2_async-io", "dep:smol_2_blocking", "dep:smol_2_futures-lite"]
tokio_1 = ["dep:tokio_1"]

[dependencies.async-std_1]
package = "async-std"
version = "1.0"
features = ["unstable"]
optional = true

[dependencies.smol_2_async-io]
package = "async-io"
version = "2.0"
features = []
optional = true

[dependencies.smol_2_blocking]
package = "blocking"
version = "1.6"
features = []
optional = true

[dependencies.smol_2_futures-lite]
package = "futures-lite"
version = "2.6"
features = []
optional = true

[dependencies.tokio_1]
package = "tokio"
version = "1.0"
features = ["time", "rt"]
optional = true

[package]
name = "tauri"
version = "2.11.5"
description = "Make tiny, secure apps for all desktop platforms with Tauri"
exclude = ["/test", "/.scripts", "CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
links = "Tauri"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.90"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
no-default-features = true
features = ["wry", "unstable", "custom-protocol", "tray-icon", "devtools", "image-png", "protocol-asset", "test", "specta", "dynamic-acl", "isolation"]
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = ["x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-linux-android", "x86_64-apple-ios"]

[package.metadata.cargo-udeps.ignore]
normal = ["reqwest"]
build = ["tauri-build"]
development = ["quickcheck_macros"]

[dependencies]
url = "2"
anyhow = "1"
thiserror = "2"
getrandom = "0.3"
serde_repr = "0.1"
http = "1"
dirs = "6"
percent-encoding = "2"
glob = "0.3"
mime = "0.3"
serialize-to-javascript = "0.1.2"
heck = "0.5"
log = "0.4.21"
dunce = "1"
cookie = "0.18"

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1"
features = ["raw_value"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["rt", "rt-multi-thread", "sync", "fs", "io-util"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tauri-runtime]
version = "2.11.3"
path = "../tauri-runtime"

[dependencies.tauri-macros]
version = "2.6.3"
path = "../tauri-macros"

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
version = "2.9.3"
features = ["resources"]
path = "../tauri-utils"

[dependencies.tauri-runtime-wry]
version = "2.11.4"
path = "../tauri-runtime-wry"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.raw-window-handle]
version = "0.6"
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.data-url]
version = "0.3"
optional = true

[dependencies.image]
version = "0.25"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.http-range]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.specta]
version = "^2.0.0-rc.16"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["function", "derive"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\", target_os = \"windows\", target_os = \"macos\"))".dependencies.muda]
version = "0.19"
default-features = false
features = ["serde", "gtk"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\", target_os = \"windows\", target_os = \"macos\"))".dependencies.tray-icon]
version = "0.24"
default-features = false
features = ["serde", "gtk"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.gtk]
version = "0.18"
features = ["v3_24"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.webkit2gtk]
version = "2"
features = ["v2_40"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies]
objc2 = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
embed_plist = "1.2"
plist = "1"
window-vibrancy = "0.6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-foundation]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSData", "NSThread"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-app-kit]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "NSApplication", "NSColor", "NSResponder", "NSView", "NSWindow", "NSImage"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.objc2-web-kit]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["objc2-app-kit", "WKWebView", "WKWebViewConfiguration", "WKUserContentController"]

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]
window-vibrancy = "0.6"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.webview2-com]
version = "0.38"
optional = true

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.61"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_UI", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"android\", all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\"))))".dependencies.bytes]
version = "1"
features = ["serde"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"android\", all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\"))))".dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.13"
default-features = false
features = ["json", "stream"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"android\", all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\"))))".dependencies.rustls]
version = "0.23"
default-features = false
features = ["ring"]
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies]
jni = "0.21"

[target."cfg(all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies]
libc = "0.2"
swift-rs = "1"

[target."cfg(all(target_vendor = \"apple\", not(target_os = \"macos\")))".dependencies.objc2-ui-kit]
version = "0.3.2"
default-features = false
features = ["UIApplication", "UIResponder", "UIView"]

[build-dependencies]
glob = "0.3"
heck = "0.5"

[build-dependencies.tauri-build]
path = "../tauri-build/"
default-features = false
version = "2.6.3"

[build-dependencies.tauri-utils]
path = "../tauri-utils/"
version = "2.9.3"
features = ["build-2"]

[dev-dependencies]
proptest = "1.6.0"
quickcheck = "1.0.3"
quickcheck_macros = "1.0.0"
serde_json = "1"
cargo_toml = "1.0"
http-range = "0.1.5"

[dev-dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dev-dependencies.tauri]
path = "."
default-features = false
features = ["wry"]

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
version = "1"
features = ["full"]

[features]
default = ["wry", "compression", "common-controls-v6", "dynamic-acl", "x11", "dbus"]
unstable = ["tauri-runtime-wry?/unstable"]
x11 = ["tauri-runtime-wry?/x11"]
dbus = ["tauri-runtime-wry?/dbus"]
common-controls-v6 = ["tray-icon?/common-controls-v6", "muda/common-controls-v6", "tauri-runtime-wry?/common-controls-v6"]
tray-icon = ["dep:tray-icon"]
tracing = ["dep:tracing", "tauri-macros/tracing", "tauri-runtime-wry?/tracing"]
test = []
compression = ["tauri-macros/compression", "tauri-utils/compression"]
wry = ["webview2-com", "webkit2gtk", "tauri-runtime-wry"]
objc-exception = []
linux-libxdo = ["tray-icon/libxdo", "muda/libxdo"]
isolation = ["tauri-utils/isolation", "tauri-macros/isolation", "uuid"]
custom-protocol = ["tauri-macros/custom-protocol"]
native-tls = ["reqwest/native-tls"]
native-tls-vendored = ["reqwest/native-tls-vendored"]
rustls-tls = ["reqwest/rustls-no-provider", "dep:rustls"]
devtools = ["tauri-runtime/devtools", "tauri-runtime-wry?/devtools"]
process-relaunch-dangerous-allow-symlink-macos = ["tauri-utils/process-relaunch-dangerous-allow-symlink-macos"]
macos-private-api = ["tauri-runtime/macos-private-api", "tauri-runtime-wry?/macos-private-api"]
webview-data-url = ["data-url", "tauri-utils/html-manipulation-2"]
protocol-asset = ["http-range"]
config-json5 = ["tauri-macros/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-macros/config-toml"]
image-ico = ["image/ico"]
image-png = ["image/png"]
macos-proxy = ["tauri-runtime-wry?/macos-proxy"]
dynamic-acl = []
specta = ["dep:specta"]

[[example]]
name = "commands"
path = "../../examples/commands/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "helloworld"
path = "../../examples/helloworld/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "drag"
path = "../../examples/drag/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "multiwebview"
path = "../../examples/multiwebview/main.rs"
required-features = ["unstable"]

[[example]]
name = "multiwindow"
path = "../../examples/multiwindow/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "run-return"
path = "../../examples/run-return/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "splashscreen"
path = "../../examples/splashscreen/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "state"
path = "../../examples/state/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "streaming"
path = "../../examples/streaming/main.rs"

[[example]]
name = "isolation"
path = "../../examples/isolation/main.rs"
required-features = ["isolation"]

[package]
name = "tauri-build"
version = "2.6.3"
description = "build time code to pair with https://crates.io/crates/tauri"
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.90"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = ["x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-linux-android", "x86_64-apple-ios"]

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1"
cargo_toml = "1.0"
serde = "1"
serde_json = "1"
heck = "0.5"
json-patch = "4"
walkdir = "2"
tauri-winres = "0.3"
semver = "1"
dirs = "6"
glob = "0.3"

[dependencies.quote]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.tauri-codegen]
version = "2.6.3"
path = "../tauri-codegen"
optional = true

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
version = "2.9.3"
path = "../tauri-utils"
features = ["build-2", "resources"]

[dependencies.schemars]
version = "0.8.21"
features = ["preserve_order"]

[features]
default = ["config-json"]
codegen = ["tauri-codegen", "quote"]
isolation = ["tauri-codegen/isolation", "tauri-utils/isolation"]
config-json = []
config-json5 = ["tauri-utils/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-utils/config-toml"]

[package]
name = "tauri-codegen"
version = "2.6.3"
description = "code generation meant to be consumed inside of `tauri` through `tauri-build` or `tauri-macros`"
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.90"

[dependencies]
sha2 = "0.10"
base64 = "0.22"
proc-macro2 = "1"
quote = "1"
syn = "2"
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
walkdir = "2"
semver = "1"
ico = "0.5"
png = "0.17"
json-patch = "4"
url = "2"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
version = "2.9.3"
path = "../tauri-utils"
features = ["build-2"]

[dependencies.brotli]
version = "8"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["v4"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
plist = "1"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.time]
version = "0.3"
features = ["parsing", "formatting"]

[features]
compression = ["brotli", "tauri-utils/compression"]
isolation = ["tauri-utils/isolation"]
config-json5 = ["tauri-utils/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-utils/config-toml"]

[package]
name = "tauri-macros"
version = "2.6.3"
description = "Macros for the tauri crate."
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.90"

[lib]
proc-macro = true

[dependencies]
quote = "1"
heck = "0.5"

[dependencies.proc-macro2]
version = "1"
features = ["span-locations"]

[dependencies.syn]
version = "2"
features = ["full"]

[dependencies.tauri-codegen]
version = "2.6.3"
default-features = false
path = "../tauri-codegen"

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
version = "2.9.3"
path = "../tauri-utils"

[features]
custom-protocol = []
compression = ["tauri-codegen/compression"]
isolation = ["tauri-codegen/isolation"]
config-json5 = ["tauri-codegen/config-json5", "tauri-utils/config-json5"]
config-toml = ["tauri-codegen/config-toml", "tauri-utils/config-toml"]
tracing = []

[package]
name = "tauri-plugin-updater"
version = "2.10.1"
description = "In-app updates for Tauri applications."
edition = "2021"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
rust-version = "1.77.2"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace"
links = "tauri-plugin-updater"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
no-default-features = true
features = ["zip"]

[package.metadata.platforms.support.windows]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.linux]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.macos]
level = "full"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.android]
level = "none"
notes = ""

[package.metadata.platforms.support.ios]
level = "none"
notes = ""

[build-dependencies.tauri-plugin]
features = ["build"]
version = "2.5"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
log = "0.4"
tokio = "1"
url = "2"
http = "1"
minisign-verify = "0.2"
base64 = "0.22"
futures-util = "0.3"
tempfile = "3.20"
infer = "0.19"
percent-encoding = "2.3"

[dependencies.tauri]
version = "2.10"
default-features = false

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.reqwest]
version = "0.13"
default-features = false
features = ["json", "stream"]

[dependencies.rustls]
version = "0.23"
default-features = false
features = ["ring"]
optional = true

[dependencies.time]
version = "0.3"
features = ["parsing", "formatting"]

[dependencies.semver]
version = "1"
features = ["serde"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.zip]
version = "4"
default-features = false
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"windows\")".dependencies.windows-sys]
version = "0.60.0"
features = ["Win32_Foundation", "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging", "Win32_UI_Shell"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies]
dirs = "6"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.tar]
version = "0.4"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"linux\")".dependencies.flate2]
version = "1"
optional = true

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies]
tar = "0.4"
flate2 = "1"

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.osakit]
version = "0.3"
features = ["full"]

[features]
default = ["rustls-tls", "zip"]
zip = ["dep:zip", "dep:tar", "dep:flate2"]
native-tls = ["reqwest/native-tls"]
native-tls-vendored = ["reqwest/native-tls-vendored"]
rustls-tls = ["reqwest/rustls-no-provider", "dep:rustls"]

[package]
name = "tauri-runtime"
version = "2.11.3"
description = "Runtime for Tauri applications"
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.90"

[package.metadata.docs.rs]
all-features = true
default-target = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"
targets = ["x86_64-pc-windows-msvc", "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu", "x86_64-apple-darwin", "x86_64-linux-android", "x86_64-apple-ios"]

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
thiserror = "2"
http = "1"
raw-window-handle = "0.6"
cookie = "0.18"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"

[features]

[package]

authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"

[dependencies]
raw-window-handle = "0.6"
http = "1"
url = "2"
log = "0.4.21"

[dependencies.wry]
version = "0.56.0"

[dependencies.tao]

[dependencies.tauri-runtime]
version = "2.11.3"

[dependencies.tauri-utils]
version = "2.9.3"
path = "../tauri-utils"

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies]
webview2-com = "0.38"
once_cell = "1.20"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.softbuffer]
version = "0.4"

[target."cfg(windows)".dependencies.windows]
version = "0.61"

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.gtk]
version = "0.18"
features = ["v3_24"]

[target."cfg(any(target_os = \"linux\", target_os = \"dragonfly\", target_os = \"freebsd\", target_os = \"openbsd\", target_os = \"netbsd\"))".dependencies.webkit2gtk]

[target."cfg(target_vendor = \"apple\")".dependencies]

default-features = false

[target."cfg(target_os = \"android\")".dependencies]
jni = "0.21"

[features]
default = ["x11", "dbus"]

unstable = []
common-controls-v6 = []

[package]
name = "tauri-utils"
version = "2.9.3"
description = "Utilities for Tauri"
exclude = ["CHANGELOG.md", "/target"]
readme = "README.md"
authors = ["Tauri Programme within The Commons Conservancy"]
homepage = "https://tauri.app/"
repository = "https://github.com/tauri-apps/tauri"
categories = ["gui", "web-programming"]
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
edition = "2021"
rust-version = "1.90"

[dependencies]
serde_json = "1"
anyhow = "1"
thiserror = "2"

glob = "0.3.1"

semver = "1"
infer = "0.22"
dunce = "1"
log = "0.4.21"
serde-untagged = "0.1"
http = "1"
plist = "1"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.phf]
version = "0.13"
features = ["macros"]

[dependencies.brotli]
version = "8"
optional = true
default-features = false
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.url]
version = "2"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.html5ever]
version = "0.29"
optional = true

[dependencies.kuchiki]
package = "kuchikiki"
version = "0.8.8-speedreader"
optional = true

[dependencies.dom_query]
version = "0.28"
optional = true
default-features = false

[dependencies.proc-macro2]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.quote]
version = "1"
optional = true

[dependencies.schemars]
version = "0.8.21"
features = ["url", "uuid1"]
optional = true

[dependencies.aes-gcm]
version = "0.10"
optional = true

[dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.3"
optional = true
features = ["std"]

[dependencies.serialize-to-javascript]
version = "0.1.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.ctor]
version = "1.0"
default-features = false

[dependencies.json5]
version = "0.4"
optional = true

[dependencies.toml]
version = ">=0.9, <=1"
features = ["parse"]

[dependencies.walkdir]
version = "2"
optional = true

[dependencies.cargo_metadata]
version = "0.19"
optional = true

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1"
features = ["serde"]

[target."cfg(target_os = \"macos\")".dependencies.swift-rs]
version = "1"
optional = true
features = ["build"]

[dev-dependencies]
serial_test = "3.5"
tempfile = "3.15.0"

[dev-dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.3"
features = ["std"]

[dev-dependencies.tauri]
path = "../tauri"

[features]
build = ["proc-macro2", "quote", "cargo_metadata", "schema", "swift-rs", "html-manipulation"]
build-2 = ["proc-macro2", "quote", "cargo_metadata", "schema", "swift-rs", "html-manipulation-2"]
compression = ["brotli"]
schema = ["schemars"]
isolation = ["aes-gcm", "getrandom", "serialize-to-javascript"]
process-relaunch-dangerous-allow-symlink-macos = []
config-json5 = ["json5"]
config-toml = []
resources = ["walkdir"]
html-manipulation = ["dep:html5ever", "dep:kuchiki"]
html-manipulation-2 = ["dep:dom_query"]
